senses.gloss: निबंध m. 1. Binding, attachment, Bg.xvi.5; 2. composing, recording; 3. any literary composition or treatise, especially a compendium; 4. restraint, obstruction, confinement; 5. supresssion of urine; 6. a bond, a fetter; 7. a grant of property, an assignment of money &c. for support, भुर्या पितामहोपात्ता निबंधो द्रव्यमेव वा Yaj.ii.121; 8. foundation, origin; 9. cause, reason.

निबंधन n. 1. The act of fastening; 2. constructing, building; 3. restraining, checking, confining; 4. bond, fetter; 5. a receptacle; 6. support, as in जीवितनिबंधन; 7. the leg of a lute; 8. cause, origin, reason, M.ix.27; 9. syntax (in gram.); 10. composing, K.S.vii.60; 11. a composition, a treatise; 12. a grant, an assignment, सद्वृत्तिः संनिबंधना Sis.ii.112 (where the word is used in the last two senses).
निबंधनी f. A bond, a fetter.
निब(व)र्हण n. Killing, destruction, annihilation, Na.i.131.
निबिड a. (f. डा) Dense, thick. See निविड.
निवि(बि)ड a. (f. डा) 1. Without space or interstices, close; 2. firm, fast, R.ix.58, xix.44; 3. thick, impervious, dense, R.xi.15; 4. crooked-nosed.
निबिड a. (f. डा) Dense, thick. See निविड.
